direction.camera: Guide attention with concise promise; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: lead with one promise then fill the frame with its evidence; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with confident launch; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with controlled energy.
direction.lighting: bright launch-stage fill; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: clean panels and saturated accent blocks; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around clean payoff; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use concise promise,confident launch,bold headline,fast proof,clean payoff,controlled energy as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
